scripts.title: Automated Dabux Navigation
scripts.features:
You must collect the dabux manually before 40 seconds of the script being used before the 2nd Teleportation happens so be quick ,Teleportation Logic
Targeting: The script automatically detects the two largest clusters.
Initial Jump: It will immediately teleport to the first (largest) cluster upon activation.
Cooldown: A 40 second delay is required after the initial jump before the script will automatically teleport to the second biggest cluster.
scripts.script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local function getRankedClusters()
    local allDabux = {}
    local clusters = {}
    
    -- 1. Scan the map for Dabux
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "Dabux" then
            local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if part then 
                table.insert(allDabux, part) 
            end
        end
    end

    -- 2. Group by density (30 stud radius)
    for _, primary in pairs(allDabux) do
        local neighbors = 0
        for _, secondary in pairs(allDabux) do
            if (primary.Position - secondary.Position).Magnitude <= 30 then
                neighbors = neighbors + 1
            end
        end
        table.insert(clusters, {cf = primary.CFrame, count = neighbors})
    end

    -- 3. Rank them
    table.sort(clusters, function(a, b) return a.count > b.count end)
    return clusters
end

-- PHASE 1: THE BIGGEST PILE
local rankedList = getRankedClusters()

if #rankedList >= 1 then
    local first = rankedList[1]
    print("Teleporting to #1 Cluster (" .. first.count .. " Dabux within 30 studs)")
    root.CFrame = first.cf * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)

    -- PHASE 2: THE 40-SECOND WAIT
    print("Teleported. Staying here for 40 seconds...")
    task.wait(40)

    -- PHASE 3: THE SECOND BIGGEST PILE
    rankedList = getRankedClusters()
    
    if #rankedList >= 2 then
        local second = rankedList[2]
        print("Moving to #2 Cluster (" .. second.count .. " Dabux within 30 studs)")
        root.CFrame = second.cf * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
        print("Finished. Enjoy your Dabux.")
    else
        print("No second cluster found.")
    end
else
    print("No Dabux found on the map.")
end

-- ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════╗

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SG:Destroy() end)
local minimized = false
MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    for _,c in ipairs(Main:GetChildren()) do
        if c ~= TBar then c.Visible = not minimized end
    end
end)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp,gpe)
    if gpe then return end
    if inp.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.End then Main.Visible = not Main.Visible end
end)

-- Window drag
local winDrag, dragSt, dragPos
TBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        winDrag=true; dragSt=i.Position; dragPos=Main.Position
    end
end)
TBar.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then winDrag=false end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if winDrag and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local d=i.Position-dragSt
        Main.Position=UDim2.new(dragPos.X.Scale, dragPos.X.Offset+d.X,
                                 dragPos.Y.Scale, dragPos.Y.Offset+d.Y)

end)

-- ── Tab bar ──

TabBar.BackgroundColor3 = T.TabBar
TabBar.BorderSizePixel  = 0
TabBar.ZIndex           = 4
TabBar.Parent           = Main
Instance.new("UIListLayout",TabBar).FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal

local topTabDefs = {"ragebot","character","world","esp","visuals"}
local topTabBtns = {}
local activeTopTab = nil

local ContentHost = Instance.new("Frame")

ContentHost.Position         = UDim2.new(0,0,0,26+TAB_H)

local topTabPages = {}

    local page = Instance.new("Frame")
    page.Size                = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
    page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    page.Visible             = false
    page.Parent              = ContentHost

    local function makePanel(xScale)
        local sf = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
        sf.Size                 = UDim2.new(0.5,-1,1,0)
        sf.Position             = UDim2.new(xScale, xScale>0 and 1 or 0, 0,0)
        sf.BackgroundColor3     = T.Panel
        sf.BorderSizePixel      = 0
        sf.ScrollBarThickness   = 2
        sf.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.Accent
        sf.CanvasSize           = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
        sf.AutomaticCanvasSize  = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        sf.ScrollingDirection   = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
        sf.Parent               = page
        local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
        l.Padding = UDim.new(0,3); l.Parent = sf
        local p = Instance.new("UIPadding")
        p.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,8); p.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,8)
        p.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,6);  p.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,8)
        p.Parent = sf
        return sf
    end

    return page, makePanel(0), makePanel(0.5)
end

for _,name in ipairs(topTabDefs) do
    local pg,L,R = makeTopTabPage()
    topTabPages[name] = {page=pg, L=L, R=R}
end

local function switchTab(name)
    for _,n in ipairs(topTabDefs) do
        topTabPages[n].page.Visible = false
        if topTabBtns[n] then
            topTabBtns[n].BackgroundColor3 = T.TabInactive
            topTabBtns[n].TextColor3       = T.SubText
        end
    end
    topTabPages[name].page.Visible = true
    activeTopTab = name
    if topTabBtns[name] then
        topTabBtns[name].BackgroundColor3 = T.TabActive
        topTabBtns[name].TextColor3       = T.Text
    end
end

for i,name in ipairs(topTabDefs) do
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size             = UDim2.new(0,math.floor(WIN_W/#topTabDefs),1,0)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = T.TabInactive
    b.BorderSizePixel  = 0
    b.Text             = name
    b.TextColor3       = T.SubText
    b.TextSize         = 10
    b.Font             = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.AutoButtonColor  = false
    b.LayoutOrder      = i
    b.Parent           = TabBar

end

    return function(v) apply(v) end,
           function() return on end,
           function(f2) table.insert(listeners,f2) end
end

local function makeSlider(parent,text,minV,maxV,def,order,cb)
    local holder=Instance.new("Frame")

    holder.LayoutOrder=order; holder.Parent=parent

    local lbl=Instance.new("TextLabel")

    lbl.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; lbl.TextSize=10
    lbl.TextColor3=T.Text; lbl.Parent=holder

    track.BackgroundColor3=T.SliderTrack; track.BorderSizePixel=0; track.Parent=holder

    fill.BorderSizePixel=0; fill.Parent=track
    Instance.new("UICorner",fill).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)

    local knob=Instance.new("Frame")

    knob.BorderSizePixel=0; knob.Parent=track

    local sDrag=false
    local function setX(x)
        local rel=math.clamp((x-track.AbsolutePosition.X)/track.AbsoluteSize.X,0,1)
        local val=math.floor(minV+(maxV-minV)*rel+0.5)
        fill.Size=UDim2.new(rel,0,1,0); knob.Position=UDim2.new(rel,-4,0.5,-4)
        lbl.Text=text.."   "..tostring(val).."/"..tostring(maxV)
        if cb then cb(val) end
    end
    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then sDrag=true; setX(i.Position.X) end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then sDrag=false end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if sDrag and i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then setX(i.Position.X) end
    end)
    if cb then cb(def) end
end

        if cb then cb(v) end

            lf.BackgroundColor3=T.DropBg; lf.BorderSizePixel=0; lf.ZIndex=60; lf.Parent=SG
            Instance.new("UICorner",lf).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,3)
            Instance.new("UIStroke",lf).Color=T.PanelBorder
            Instance.new("UIListLayout",lf)
            for _,opt in ipairs(opts) do
                local ob=Instance.new("TextButton")
                ob.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,20); ob.BackgroundTransparency=1
                ob.Text=opt; ob.TextColor3=T.SubText; ob.TextSize=10
                ob.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; ob.AutoButtonColor=false
                ob.ZIndex=61; ob.Parent=lf
                ob.MouseEnter:Connect(function() ob.TextColor3=T.Text end)
                ob.MouseLeave:Connect(function() ob.TextColor3=T.SubText end)
                ob.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(opt); close() end)
            end
        else close() end
    end)

local function findClosestPlayer(fovPx)
    local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
    local ctr=Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X/2,cam.ViewportSize.Y/2)
    local bestPart, bestDist = nil, fovPx or math.huge
    for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=player and p.Character then
            local head=p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
                     or p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head then
                local sp,onSc=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                if onSc then
                    local d=(Vector2.new(sp.X,sp.Y)-ctr).Magnitude
                    if d<bestDist then bestDist=d; bestPart=head end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPart
end

local function getVelocity(part)
    local vel=Vector3.zero
    pcall(function()
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then vel=part.AssemblyLinearVelocity end
    end)
    return vel
end

-- Redirect mouse.Hit / mouse.Target to the closest player
local silentConn=nil
local function startSilentAim()
    if silentConn then silentConn:Disconnect() end
    silentConn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not silentActive then
            local mt=getmetatable(mouse); if mt then mt.__index=nil end
            silentConn:Disconnect(); silentConn=nil; return
        end
        local part=findClosestPlayer(silentFOV)
        if part then
            local vel=getVelocity(part)
            local pred=part.Position+vel*0.08
            local mt=getmetatable(mouse)
            if mt then
                mt.__index=function(_,k)
                    if k=="Hit"    then return CFrame.new(pred) end
                    if k=="Target" then return part end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end
local function stopSilentAim()
    silentActive=false
    if silentConn then silentConn:Disconnect(); silentConn=nil end
    pcall(function() local mt=getmetatable(mouse); if mt then mt.__index=nil end end)
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- RAGEBOT ORBIT SYSTEM
-- Orbits your character around its current position
-- at high speed and auto-fires with silent aim every
-- ragebotDelay seconds at the closest player
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function stopRagebot()
    ragebotActive=false
    if ragebotConn then ragebotConn:Disconnect(); ragebotConn=nil end
    stopSilentAim()
    -- restore physics
    local r=getRoot()
    if r then
        local bv=r:FindFirstChild("_RB_BV"); if bv then bv:Destroy() end
        local bg=r:FindFirstChild("_RB_BG"); if bg then bg:Destroy() end
    end
    local h=getHum(); if h then h.PlatformStand=false end
end

local function startRagebot()
    stopRagebot()
    ragebotActive=true
    silentActive=true; startSilentAim()

    local root=getRoot(); if not root then return end
    local hum=getHum();   if not hum  then return end

    -- Save orbit center at current position
    local orbitCenter=root.Position

    -- Give body movers so we fully control position
    hum.PlatformStand=true
    local bv=Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.Name="_RB_BV"; bv.Velocity=Vector3.zero
    bv.MaxForce=Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5); bv.Parent=root
    local bg=Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.Name="_RB_BG"; bg.MaxTorque=Vector3.new(1e5,1e5,1e5)
    bg.P=1e4; bg.Parent=root

    ragebotAngle=0

    ragebotConn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not ragebotActive then stopRagebot(); return end
        local r2=getRoot(); if not r2 then stopRagebot(); return end

        -- advance orbit angle
        ragebotAngle=ragebotAngle+(ragebotSpeed*2*math.pi)*dt

        local ox=orbitCenter.X+math.cos(ragebotAngle)*ragebotRadius
        local oz=orbitCenter.Z+math.sin(ragebotAngle)*ragebotRadius
        local oy=orbitCenter.Y+1  -- stay just above ground

        -- face the orbit tangent direction (looks like spinning)
        local tx=-math.sin(ragebotAngle)
        local tz=math.cos(ragebotAngle)
        local targetCF=CFrame.new(Vector3.new(ox,oy,oz),Vector3.new(ox+tx,oy,oz+tz))

        r2.CFrame=targetCF

        -- keep body movers zeroed (position is set by CFrame directly)
        local bv2=r2:FindFirstChild("_RB_BV")
        if bv2 then bv2.Velocity=Vector3.zero end
        local bg2=r2:FindFirstChild("_RB_BG")
        if bg2 then bg2.CFrame=targetCF end

        -- auto fire toward closest player via tool
        if ragebotFire then
            local now=tick()
            if now-lastShotTime>=ragebotDelay then
                lastShotTime=now
                local char=getChar()
                local tool=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if tool then
                    -- fire all remote events on the tool (works for most shooters)
                    for _,v in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
                        if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                            pcall(function()
                                -- silent aim already redirects mouse.Hit so the
                                -- server receives the redirected hit position
                                v:FireServer(mouse.Hit, mouse.Target)
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    -- also attempt ClickDetector style
                    local handle=tool:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
                    if handle then
                        local cd=handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
                        if cd then pcall(function() fireClickDetector(cd) end) end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- DESYNC (character orbit at sky height — server
-- can't track position so damage won't register)
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function stopDesync()
    desyncActive=false
    if desyncConn then desyncConn:Disconnect(); desyncConn=nil end
    task.delay(0.05,function()
        local r=getRoot()
        if r and desyncSavedCF then
            pcall(function() r.CFrame=desyncSavedCF end)
        end
    end)
end

local function startDesync()
    stopDesync()
    desyncActive=true
    local r=getRoot(); if not r then return end
    desyncSavedCF=r.CFrame
    desyncAngle=0
    desyncConn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not desyncActive then stopDesync(); return end
        local r2=getRoot(); if not r2 then return end
        desyncAngle=desyncAngle+(desyncSpeed*2*math.pi)*dt
        local origin=desyncSavedCF.Position
        local ox=origin.X+math.cos(desyncAngle)*desyncRadius
        local oz=origin.Z+math.sin(desyncAngle)*desyncRadius
        local oy=origin.Y+desyncHeight
        local tx=-math.sin(desyncAngle); local tz=math.cos(desyncAngle)
        r2.CFrame=CFrame.new(Vector3.new(ox,oy,oz),Vector3.new(ox+tx,oy,oz+tz))
    end)
end

    end
